## Check your understanding

1. Exact-match accuracy jumps from 0% to 60%, while a graded similarity measure increases steadily. Which conclusion is justified?
2. Why is a comparison between only two model sizes insufficient to isolate the effect of scale?
3. Propose a protocol for testing whether a capability truly appears discontinuously.
